Lab 3: Netmiko backup and a CLI change

Corvane Logistics wants a nightly configuration backup of both edge routers, plus one small CLI change, all from a Python script.

1. Device login is student / labpass; use Netmiko with device_type='cisco_ios'.
2. Connect to corvane-r1 and corvane-r2, run show running-config on each and save the output to ~/backups/<hostname>.cfg.
3. On corvane-r2, set the description of GigabitEthernet4 to exactly spare - audited and save the configuration.

lab_tasks:
Tutor demo: bring up a link on the real router

Corvane Logistics is adding a dock segment behind corvane-r3, a real IOS router. Its port Ethernet0/2 needs an address and has to come up.

1. Log in to the router with ssh student@corvane-r3 (password labpass).
2. Give Ethernet0/2 the address 10.20.32.1 with a /24 mask, and bring the interface up.
3. Check it with show ip interface brief, leave the router with exit.
4. Type lab check to see which parts pass.
